# Console

Allocating, reading and writing the console.

<h2 id="write-console-w"><code>WriteConsoleW</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func WriteConsoleW(
    consoleOutput: *var opaque,
    buffer: *opaque,
    numberOfCharsToWrite: uint32,
    numberOfCharsWritten: *var uint32,
    reserved: *var opaque
) -> int32

pub extern func WriteConsoleW(
    consoleOutput: *opaque,
    buffer: *char16,
    numberOfCharsToWrite: uint32,
    numberOfCharsWritten: *uint32,
    reserved: *opaque
) -> bool32
```

Writes a character string to a console screen buffer beginning at the current cursor location.

| Overload                                                                                                                                                                      | Summary                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub extern func WriteConsoleW(consoleOutput: *var opaque, buffer: *opaque, numberOfCharsToWrite: uint32, numberOfCharsWritten: *var uint32, reserved: *var opaque) -> int32` | Writes UTF-16 to a console screen buffer.                                                      |
| `pub extern func WriteConsoleW(consoleOutput: *opaque, buffer: *char16, numberOfCharsToWrite: uint32, numberOfCharsWritten: *uint32, reserved: *opaque) -> bool32`            | Writes a character string to a console screen buffer beginning at the current cursor location. |

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/console/writeconsole](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/console/writeconsole)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/File.rux#L324)

**Parameters**

| Name                   | Type                      | Description                    |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `consoleOutput`        | `*var opaque` / `*opaque` | a console output handle        |
| `buffer`               | `*opaque` / `*char16`     | the bytes                      |
| `numberOfCharsToWrite` | `uint32`                  | how many units to write        |
| `numberOfCharsWritten` | `*var uint32` / `*uint32` | receives how many were written |
| `reserved`             | `*var opaque` / `*opaque` | reserved; pass null            |

**Returns**: non-zero on success, and zero on failure with the reason in [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error)

<h2 id="read-console-w"><code>ReadConsoleW</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func ReadConsoleW(
    consoleInput: *var opaque,
    buffer: *var opaque,
    numberOfCharsToRead: uint32,
    numberOfCharsRead: *var uint32,
    inputControl: *var opaque
) -> int32
```

Reads UTF-16 from a console input buffer.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/console/readconsole](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/console/readconsole)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/File.rux#L336)

**Parameters**

| Name                  | Type          | Description                      |
| --------------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `consoleInput`        | `*var opaque` | a console input handle           |
| `buffer`              | `*var opaque` | the bytes                        |
| `numberOfCharsToRead` | `uint32`      | how many units to ask for        |
| `numberOfCharsRead`   | `*var uint32` | receives how many were read      |
| `inputControl`        | `*var opaque` | an input-control record, or null |

**Returns**: non-zero on success

<h2 id="get-console-mode"><code>GetConsoleMode</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func GetConsoleMode(
    consoleHandle: *opaque,

```

Retrieves the current input or output mode of a console screen buffer.

**Parameters**

| Name            | Type      | Description                    |
| --------------- | --------- | ------------------------------ |
| `consoleHandle` | `*opaque` | a console handle               |
| `mode`          | `*uint32` | receives the console mode bits |

**Returns**: non-zero on success, and zero on failure with the reason in [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error)

<h2 id="get-std-handle"><code>GetStdHandle</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func GetStdHandle(stdHandle: uint32) -> *opaque
```

Retrieves a handle to the specified standard device (standard input, standard output, or standard error).

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/console/getstdhandle](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/console/getstdhandle)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L228)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stdHandle` | `uint32` | one of [`StdInputHandle`](/docs/api/windows/console#std-input-handle), [`StdOutputHandle`](/docs/api/windows/console#std-output-handle) or [`StdErrorHandle`](/docs/api/windows/console#std-error-handle) |

**Returns**: the standard handle, or [`InvalidHandleValue`](/docs/api/windows/types#invalid-handle-value)
